name: Flourish
description: Flourish Connector turns Claude into a chart-making assistant for real Flourish projects. Give it data and describe the insight you want to highlight or the story you want to tell. It chooses a suitable template, prepares the data, creates the visualization in your Flourish account, and gives you an edit link. You stay in control of the final polish and publishing in Flourish. No screenshots or throwaway code. Just interactive, editable charts with the access, collaboration, branding, and publishing features your plan includes.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Flourish to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Flourish to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://app.flourish.studio/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Flourish MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Flourish provides these MCP tools: flourish_list_templates, flourish_list_visualisations, flourish_get_template_details, flourish_get_visualisation_data, flourish_get_visualisation_settings, flourish_create_visualisation, flourish_duplicate_visualisation, flourish_update_visualisation_data_bindings, flourish_update_visualisation_data, and flourish_update_visualisation_settings.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Flourish?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Flourish in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.
Flourish requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Flourish is developed by Flourish. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
